Liam — thanks for the detail, this is actionable. Quick answers + an updated provisional sizing pulled into the spreadsheet (see workload_sizing_sheet.xlsx). High level: 

1) Model & cost delta
   - rwd-llama-70b-q4 (quant): ~0.85 USD / 1M prompt+completion tokens (hosted estimate); good for high-quality long-context summarization when quantized kernels are available.
   - rwd-guanaco-13b-8k (13B): ~0.22 USD / 1M tokens; faster per-token but may need ensemble or extra prompting for parity on long summarization.
   - rwd-mistral-8x-instruct: ~0.30 USD / 1M tokens; recommended for chat-heavy low-context interactions.

2) Caching/prefix benefits
   - For repeated excerpt summarization, prefix/KV caching can reduce compute if the same document prefixes are requested frequently. For your workflow (many unique reports) caching value is moderate. We recommend enabling automatic KV caching for any long-running sessions and retaining prefixes for 24–72h for analyst re-queries.

3) GPU / sizing notes for 16k headroom
   - Hosted: 80–100 ms per 1k tokens p50 on L4/H100-like infra (depends on kernel set), but p95 will increase. We recommend provisioned Dedicated on A100-80GB class or H100 for consistent 16k inference performance.
   - Suggested Dedicated starting pool: 3x H100 (or equivalent) with continuous batching + 2x spare burst GPUs. This supports ~40–60 concurrent summaries at 16k with P95 ~2.5s (depending on batching).

4) Provisional throughput/cost calc (from spreadsheet)
   - Monthly tokens (docs): 2,500 daily * 1,600 tokens * 22 working days = ~88M tokens/month (summarization).
   - Chat tokens: 6,000 q/day * avg 300 tokens (context+reply) * 22 days = ~39.6M tokens/month.
   - Total monthly tokens ~127.6M -> hosted estimate monthly spend on rwd-guanaco-13b ~28 USDk, on rwd-llama-70b-q4 ~108 USDk (very approximate; committed Dedicated pricing reduces unit cost).

Next steps we propose:
- Tessa and Priyom will build a 3-step test matrix for the initial 2-week POC (shortlisting models: 13B, 70B-quant, and mistral variant) including latency/cost/quality checkpoints.
- Marissa: schedule the kickoff + share access to a small sample corpus (we only need 50 representative docs to start).

I'll update the sizing sheet with GPU assumptions and a breakout of the math by Tue 2026-03-10 EOD.
